previous_statement: Fix W_RF, an admissible input and supplied setting S, and a supplied Delta-prime, and assume 0 <= eta <= rho_Delta. Put D := C_Delta-prime and d := (C_T+D)*eta. Since rho_Delta <= rho_unit and rho_Delta <= rho_Delta-prime, lem-routef-raw-factor-units and lem-routef-delta-prime-closeness give that Delta-prime is CP, ||Delta-prime-tilde-Delta||_cb <= D*eta, and ||tilde-Delta(I)-I|| <= C_T*eta. Hence, for a := Delta-prime(I), positivity of Delta-prime gives a >= 0 and the triangle inequality gives ||a-I|| <= d. Moreover rho_Delta <= [2*(C_T+D)]^(-1), while C_T and D=C_T+4*C_theta are positive by def-routef-raw-factor-setting together with lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation; therefore 0 <= d <= 1/2.
new_statement: Fix W_RF, an admissible input and supplied setting S, and a Delta' supplied by lem-routef-delta-prime-closeness, and assume 0 <= eta <= rho_Delta. Put D := C_Delta' and d := (C_T+D)*eta. By def-routef-raw-factor-setting, rho_Delta <= rho_unit and rho_Delta <= rho_Delta'. Thus lem-routef-raw-factor-units and lem-routef-delta-prime-closeness give that Delta' is CP, ||Delta'-tilde-Delta||_cb <= D*eta, and ||tilde-Delta(I)-I|| <= C_T*eta. Hence a:=Delta'(I) is positive and ||a-I|| <= ||Delta'(I)-tilde-Delta(I)||+||tilde-Delta(I)-I|| <= d. Also C_theta=12*(sqrt(2)-1)>0 and, by lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation and def-routef-raw-factor-setting, C_A>0, bar(C_E)>=1, C_V=bar(C_E)*C_A>0, C_T=C_theta+3*C_V>0, and D=C_T+4*C_theta>0. Since rho_Delta <= [2*(C_T+D)]^(-1), 0 <= eta <= rho_Delta implies 0 <= d <= 1/2.
